purpose: Auditable separation of development/tuning cases from a frozen final-check candidate set.

regression.role: Development and tuning only; may be inspected while changing prompts/rules.

held_out.role: Frozen final-check candidate set; do not inspect predictions to tune classifier.
held_out.limitation: Synthetic and provisional labels; not an independent supplied-response benchmark until independently annotated and adjudicated. A new supplied-response holdout is still needed for stronger external validity.

comparison_policy: Baseline and classifier must be scored against identical successful cases for matched-subset quality metrics.
Report full-cohort coverage and failures separately; do not silently count failed calls as negative predictions.
Replay metrics are software/regression evidence, not live LLM quality evidence.
Report per-label precision, recall, F1, support and exact-match agreement.
annotation_policy: Supplied development labels are single-annotator and carry rationale/category/evidence metadata.
At least two required synthetic edge cases are explicitly flagged in the JSONL.
Held-out candidate labels require blinded double annotation and third-party adjudication for disagreements before independent-ground-truth claims.
